name: Ignored Catch
description: ``catch`` does not check that the caught exception exists. It simply checks that the raised exception match the class name, its parent or its interface. When a typo happens in the class name or the class does not exists, the clause fails every time.
code:
<?php

    try {
        callSomeMethod();
    } catch (\UndefinedException $e) {
        die('This never happens');
    } catch (\Exception) {
        // process the error here
    }

?>
